_read_me: The launcher's settings, each at its default. To change one, copy this file into the launcher's data folder and edit that copy (this one is replaced by every update). Out of range: the nearest end is used; anything else wrong: the default. The log says which.
_catalog_every_hours: 4 to 168 (or 0, off), hours: the games catalog fetched again while the launcher stays open
_catalog_at_start: 0 to 1, 1 on, 0 off: the games catalog fetched at the start (off: new games only on CHECK FOR UPDATES)
_catalog_seconds: 5 to 120, seconds: time allowed for the catalog, and again for its signature
_art_seconds: 5 to 120, seconds: time allowed for a badge or card the catalog names
_releases_seconds: 5 to 120, seconds: time allowed for a game's releases list
_releases_count: 10 to 40, releases: releases asked for in each game's list
_update_check_seconds: 5 to 120, seconds: time allowed for the launcher's own releases list
_update_check_count: 20 to 100, releases: releases asked for in the launcher's list
_sums_seconds: 15 to 300, seconds: time allowed for a package's SHA256SUMS
_sums_signature_seconds: 10 to 300, seconds: time allowed for its signature
_download_connect_seconds: 5 to 120, seconds: a download gives up when it cannot connect in this long
_download_slow_bytes_per_second: 1 to 65536, bytes a second: a download slower than this...
_download_slow_seconds: 15 to 600, seconds: ...for this long is given up
_game_first_frame_seconds: 5 to 300, seconds: after PLAY, how long before the status line says the game is slow to start
_game_status_seconds: 3 to 120, seconds: time allowed for a game's status at the start
_game_status_press_seconds: 5 to 300, seconds: the same, asked again when PLAY finds it unknown
_game_setup_describe_seconds: 3 to 60, seconds: time allowed for a game to say what its setup offers
_game_setup_search_seconds: 30 to 600, seconds: time allowed for a game's search for its files
_mac_disk_image_seconds: 30 to 600, seconds: Mac: time allowed to open an update's or a game's disk image
_linux_appimage_seconds: 60 to 3600, seconds: Linux: time allowed to unpack a game's AppImage
_windows_uninstaller_seconds: 60 to 1800, seconds: Windows: time allowed for a game's own uninstaller
_bar_setup_share: 0 to 0.5, fraction: the setting-up step's share of one progress bar
_bar_speed_seconds: 1 to 30, seconds: the speed shown is the average over this long
_bar_starting_seconds: 0 to 10, seconds: "starting..." until the bytes have come this long
_bar_waiting_seconds: 3 to 120, seconds: "waiting for the server..." after this long without a byte
_log_progress_seconds: 1 to 60, seconds: a running download's log line at most this often
_window_width: 640 to 7680, pixels: the window's width at the start (--window WxH wins)
_vsync: 0 to 1, 1 on, 0 off: frames paced to the display
_frames_without_vsync: 30 to 240, a second: frames a second when vsync is off
_hidden_wake_ms: 50 to 500, milliseconds: while covered, minimized or behind a game, the launcher wakes this often
_sound_hover_volume: 0 to 1, 0 to 1: the menu's rollover sound
_sound_select_volume: 0 to 1, 0 to 1: the menu's select sound
